description: Regression: socket reads do not split multiline triggers. If a game line is sent while a partial line is displayed, Rune commits that partial line instead of dropping it.

scenarios.name: socket fragmentation does not split a multiline trigger

steps.server_line: You tell Player: A long example starts

steps.note: the next physical line is split across socket reads
the partial line is visible in the prompt overlay

steps.server_line: onto the final physical line FINAL

steps.expect_printed: E2E-TELL=[A long example starts and continues onto the final physical line FINAL]

scenarios.name: a game send commits a partial line
init_lua: if not confirmed and not save_scheduled and line:clean() == 'E2E-FIRST-FRAGMENT' then

steps.note: an ordinary line happens to stop at a socket-read boundary
the game send commits the partial line
the first fragment remains visible in scrollback
